description: French B2B prospecting and lead generation: build company lists over the full French registry, filtered by NAF activity code, departement/postal code, legal form, workforce, age, RGE certification, gender-equality index. Returns up to 100 active companies per page; each page is one x402 payment ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

code_postal.description: Postal-code prefix (2-5 digits), exclusive with departement

departement.description: Registered-office departement, by postal code: 01-19, 21-95, 971-978; 2A, 2B, 984, 986-989 refused for now (400 departement_non_servi, not charged); exclusive with code_postal; a narrow read (departement=978, code_postal=20 or code_postal=97150) may for now exceed the 8 s budget and return 503 budget_depasse, not charged

egapro_min.description: Minimum gender-equality index (0-100) of the latest published year; a company whose latest year is not computable is excluded

naf.description: NAF/APE code or prefix, at least two digits (62, 62.0, 62.01, 62.01Z): only the NAF rev. 2 form is retained (sub-class 62.01Z, and its levels: division 62, group 62.0, class 62.01); a code of an older nomenclature (NAF rev. 1: 55.3A, activity not recoded since rev. 2 came into force) is not, nor is INSEE's provisional value 00.00Z (no division 00 in NAF rev. 2); any other code is refused (400, not charged); a well-formed code absent from INSEE's official NAF rev. 2 list (732 sub-classes, and their classes, groups and divisions), nomenclature of the stock served (NAFRev2), a NAF 2025 code included (62.10Y, group 46.8), is refused as a criterion, with a 400 never charged: NAF 2025 becomes targetable from the first NAF25-coded stock, expected in February 2027

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: prospect_french_companies

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Prospect French companies
